ja235:1.1: Vacchanakha, households are pleasant, having gold and having food,
ja235:1.3: Where, after eating and drinking, you can lie down free from desire.
ja235:2.1: No houses for the one who does not exert himself,
ja235:2.3: No houses for the one with a stick, who does not defraud others,
ja235:2.5: So being faulty and hard to endure,
ja235:2.6: who would practice in a house?
